preconditions.name: cmd-invokable
preconditions.justification: The executor for this test is 'command_prompt', indicating the attack requires the ability to invoke commands via cmd.exe.

preconditions.name: user-has-write-access-hkcu-run-key
preconditions.justification: The registry key targeted is under HKCU, so the user must have write access to their own registry hive.

effects.name: registry-run-key-set
effects.justification: The test adds a value ('Atomic Red Team') to HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run, establishing persistence via the Run key.

effects.name: registry-key-written
effects.justification: A new registry value is written as part of the persistence mechanism, as described in the YAML and implied by successful execution.

unconsumed_or_uncertain.name: process-spawned
unconsumed_or_uncertain.note: The test only modifies the registry and does not directly spawn a new process as part of the persistence action; process creation would occur on next logon, not during the test.

unconsumed_or_uncertain.name: file-created
unconsumed_or_uncertain.note: No evidence in the YAML or execution output that a new file is created as part of this specific test; only a registry value is set.
